title: CRITICAL: provisioning carve-out lets any peer forge inviter==local-node_id invitation and read group master_secret
description: File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_invite.py:63-90 + groups_collection.py join_key :643-695. render_post has NO auth gate; pubkey lookup miss + inviter==node_id branch performs ZERO verification, records attacker-chosen role (admin), then join_key serves {master_secret,master_salt,key_epoch} over attacker's own pairwise context. CONFIRMED via live read-only harness replica of shipped test wiring (CHANGED returned, role=admin stored, 32-byte secret leaked). Exploit chain: POST invite {group_id,inviter:<local node id>,role:'admin',expires:<future>,signature:junk} -> record_invitation -> GET/POST key -> secret + admins[] membership. Fix: carve-out MUST require locally-trusted origin (LCI loopback OR pairwise identity==node_id) and/or pin node's own pubkey so even local docs verify. No OSCORE-free path may reach verification skip.
close_reason: Fixed: inviter==node_id provisioning carve-out now requires locally trusted origin only (_origin_locally_trusted: LCI loopback admin OR pairwise OSCORE identity==node_id, shared helper in groups_collection.py mirroring messaging._peer_is_local_admin firmware semantics). Wire deliveries claiming inviter==node_id must pin node's own pubkey via new node_pubkey registry param and pass schnorr48 verification exactly like foreign inviters; unpinned+untrusted+unsigned => 4.03. Legit LOCAL provisioning kept end-to-end (vector test via [::1] LCI client). Live-harness replica: forged invite -> 4.03/131, ledger empty, attacker join_key -> 4.03 with zero bytes of master_secret disclosed. tests/coap groups: 87 passed.
